exposure: family history of female pelvic floor disorders
symptoms of chronic cough or rhinitis
cohort: The participants were Chinese women aged 20 years and older from Guangzhou.
finding: Old age, increased BMI, childbirth, family history of pelvic floor disorders, chronic cough or rhinitis symptoms, wearing a corset, and frequent drinking were identified as independent risk factors for urinary incontinence.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was identified as one of the two factors with the greatest impact on urinary incontinence among the studied factors.
